content.short: Huma Finance is a PayFi protocol enabling undercollateralized lending by tokenizing real-world income and receivables.
content.description:
Huma Finance is a pioneering Payment Finance (PayFi) protocol that bridges decentralized finance with real-world credit. Recently securing $38 million in funding to expand its PayFi network, Huma enables undercollateralized lending by allowing businesses to borrow against future income streams and receivables. This approach tokenizes real-world receivables, providing instant liquidity to creditworthy borrowers without traditional 1:1 asset backing.

The protocol features a modular risk-assessment engine and offers both permissionless and institutional-grade lending environments. With its HUMA tokenomics designed for sustainable growth, Huma provides a transparent infrastructure for global payments. By focusing on real-world asset (RWA) utilization, it continues to scale as a critical bridge between legacy finance and the evolving blockchain ecosystem.
